observations.frame: U top, D bottom, F front, B back, R right, L left. Every grid is viewed from outside. For F/R/B/L, row 3 touches D. For U the top of the grid touches B; for D the top touches F. Rows are top to bottom; columns left to right.

definitions.cross: Bottom cross: D edge-center cells (row1 col2, row2 col1, row2 col3, row3 col2) equal D center, AND row3 col2 of EACH side F,R,B,L equals its own face center. Ignore D corners.
definitions.firstLayer: Bottom first layer: all nine D cells equal D center AND all three cells in row3 of EACH side F,R,B,L equal that side center. Ignore upper side rows and U.
definitions.lowerTwo: Lower two layers: bottom first layer as defined above is complete AND all three cells in row2 of EACH side F,R,B,L equal that side center. Ignore row1 of sides and U.
definitions.solved: Entire cube: every cell of each of the six faces equals that face center.

instructions.strategy: Use this beginner progression. If the cube is entirely solved, choose solved. Otherwise, if the lower two layers are complete, choose last-layer. Otherwise, if the first layer is complete, choose middle-layer. Otherwise, if the cross is complete, choose first-layer. Otherwise either daisy or cross is acceptable: daisy is a scaffold for the cross, while cross means direct cross construction. Never dismantle a complete cross to make a daisy. This experiment stops at the last-layer handoff; it does not choose among last-layer algorithms.
instructions.task: Choose the next goal. Use your previous assessments as the working progress description. They are model observations, not answers from a solver.

criteria.daisy: Build a temporary daisy for an incomplete bottom cross
criteria.cross: Build or finish the bottom cross directly
criteria.first-layer: Finish bottom corners while retaining the completed cross
criteria.middle-layer: Solve middle edges while retaining the completed first layer
criteria.last-layer: Work on the last layer while preserving the completed lower two layers
criteria.solved: The entire cube is solved; stop
